Which District Am I In?

If you are unsure about which district you are in, please follow these few steps before giving us a call.

  1. Check your bill – your statement shows who is servicing your water. Sometimes your water comes from an irrigation district, but your water can also be serviced from the city.
  2. View the Idaho Department of Water Resources’ Irrigation Organizations Map. This map is very useful however, if your water is serviced by the city, you will not be able to see that using this map. We recommend double checking your statement in order to know who is servicing your water.

If after checking your statement and other resources, you are still unsure of your provider, feel free to give us a call.

How to Use This Map

  1. Input the address you’re looking for in the white search bar.
  2. Once you hit search, it will pinpoint the address.
  3. Zoom out so that you can see the district outlines more clearly.
  4. Move your mouse to rest right next to your pinpointed address and click.
  5. You should see a white box pop up that tells you which irrigation district this address is in and you see the district boundaries outlined and highlighted. To see more boundaries, simply zoom out more.

It should look something like this:
